episodeTitle.en: 90 minutes of unfiltered product advice from Snap and Discord’s product chief | Peter Sellis
episodeTitle.zh: Snap 与 Discord 产品负责人的 90 分钟坦诚建议｜Peter Sellis

guestBioOfficial.zh: Peter Sellis 是 Snapchat 第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，后来出任 Discord 产品负责人。受访时他已离开 Discord，正在两份工作之间，得以回头谈订阅、创作工具和产品经理的判断力。
guestBioOfficial.en: Snapchat’s first PM, Peter Sellis spent seven years there before leading product at Discord. Between roles at the time of the interview, he looks back on subscriptions, creation tools, and how product managers make decisions.

title.en: 90 minutes of unfiltered product advice from Snap and Discord’s product chief | Peter Sellis
title.zh: Snap 与 Discord 产品负责人的 90 分钟坦诚建议｜Peter Sellis

summary.zh: 一款每天打开的聊天工具，用户什么时候才愿意付费？Peter 把 Snapchat+ 和 Discord Nitro 放在一起分析，又用创作工具讨论谁会成为新的创作者。最后，他谈到做决策时为何同时需要确信和谦逊。
summary.en: Peter compares the timing of subscriptions at Snapchat and Discord, then asks who can become a creator when tools get easier. He closes the loop by examining the conviction and humility product decisions demand.

insights.title: 通讯工具的订阅价值需要时间显现
insights.detail: 用户通常先养成每天使用的习惯，才会感受到额外付费功能的价值。Peter 用这点回看 Snapchat+ 的推出时机。
insights.detailEn: Messaging users often need a daily habit before paid extras make sense. Peter uses that lag to reconsider when Snapchat+ launched.

insights.title: 衡量创作工具，也要看谁第一次开始创作
insights.detail: 门槛下降能让已有创作者做得更多，也能让过去被排除的人第一次表达自己。后者会改变产品的用户群。
insights.detailEn: Easier tools increase existing creators’ output and bring in people who previously could not participate.

insights.title: 产品判断里要同时容得下确信和谦逊
insights.detail: Peter 认为，带队选择一条路需要很强的信念，而识别自己哪里可能错了又需要谦逊。两者缺一，团队都容易失去方向。
insights.detailEn: Conviction helps a PM commit a team to a direction; humility makes it possible to notice when that direction needs revisiting.

related.reason: 继续看产品经理如何在不确定条件下做判断和选择。
related.reasonEn: How product managers exercise judgment under uncertainty.
